done_when: Close runs its tests locally unless a required check runs the repo's tests; a repo whose checks hold no test job gets local tests at close, and doctor warns when the test command looks like a change selector rather than the full suite
why: In a client repo whose forge.toml lists only forge-pr-check under checks and sets no test_place, repo.test_place picks ci mode, so close skips its local tests and waits only for checks that run no app tests, and says Ready with no app test run; the nightly full run also runs the test command, which may be a change selector
